title.id: Undang-Undang yang menetapkan gaji Pejabat Pendaftar Hak Milik dan Pemeriksa Hak Milik untuk Kota Manila, yang diangkat sesuai dengan ketentuan Undang-Undang Nomor 496 berjudul “Pendaftaran Tanah”
title.ms: Akta yang menetapkan gaji Pendaftar Harta Tanah dan Pemeriksa Hak Milik bagi Bandar Manila yang dilantik mengikut ketentuan Akta Nombor 496 bertajuk Pendaftaran Tanah

text.en:
In accordance with section thirteen of Act Numbered Four hundred and ninety-six, entitled "The
Land Registration Act," the salary of the Register of Deeds for the city of Manila is hereby fixed at two
thousand dollars per annum; and the salary of the Examiner of Titles for the city of Manila, is hereby fixed at
one thousand five hundred dollars per annum; both in money of the United States.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, January 30, 1903.
